definitions.S: exp(mean(log(recorded W_CL) - log(recorded W_L))), paired by round and condition.
definitions.T_L: Arithmetic mean of per-trial Lease measured_window_ns / in-window commits (ns).
definitions.commit_cdf: Pool the ten rounds by summing counts at each lower_ns. Bucket-resolution empirical CDF; exact within-bucket latencies are unavailable. Mass is placed at each recorded lower bound. Histograms cover commits arriving inside the nominal window, including their post-window drain.
definitions.criteria: Inclusive bounds, computed at full precision before serialization.
definitions.h: Arithmetic mean of CoarseLock trial mean read critical section (ns).
definitions.h_p95: Arithmetic mean of CoarseLock trial p95 read critical section (ns).
definitions.intervention: Use result.throughput.write_ops_per_sec for S and the same condition's measured_window_ns / write_ops_completed_in_window for T_L. The earlier intervention analyzer used count / 10 s; it is not used here. Recorded W uses its measured window.
definitions.precision: JSON floats: twelve fixed decimal places; comparisons use unrounded values.
definitions.read_quantiles: Per-trial points and median line; means in table. These percentiles cannot identify modes.
definitions.residual: log(S) - log(predicted); each cell has equal weight.
definitions.rounds: Five paired rounds per intervention cell; ten per other selected cell. Read quantiles and settled CDFs each use ten rounds per arm.
definitions.x: h / T_L; T_L also enters S, so some coupling remains.
definitions.zero_log_handling: Keep zero bucket counts in total and cumulative probability. For display only, place zero at half the smallest positive lower_ns across all four series of that phase; annotate its mass. Positive buckets are unmodified.

uncertainties: Exploratory, with shared Lease throughput/cycle coupling; no confirmatory interpretation.
Read percentiles cannot determine bimodality or any other number of modes.
Commit CDF timing is resolved only to histogram lower bounds; operation counts weight pooled rounds.
